Incident-Bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: prod.gateway error_rate+timeouts elevated (5xx+timeout > 1% over 3m) — alert=ALRT-20260315-303 
Priya Kaur: Im up. seeing elevated 504/502 from two upstreams (transedge + mirroredge). paging on-call now. starting triage.
Marco Li: no deploys from infra team. checking gateway pods and kube events.
Ben Ortiz: confirmed no prod deploys. vendor (TransEdge) reported intermittent 502s at 14:03Z, MirrorEdge shows increased queueing.
Priya Kaur: quick aggregated logs from 14:02-14:06Z:
```
14:02:12Z gateway-1 ERROR upstream=transedge status=504 path=/v1/generate
14:02:13Z gateway-3 ERROR upstream=mirroredge status=502 path=/v1/embeddings
14:04:00Z gateway-2 WARN upstream=transedge latency=1.8s inflight=42
summary: total_reqs=95k window=5m, 5xx=1300 (1.37%), timeouts=340
```
Priya Kaur: impact: user-facing failed generations and higher latency. Many retries appear to be amplifying inflight. Severity P2, but could escalate.
Marco Li: mitigation suggestions: 1) circuit-breaker on transedge/mirroredge 2) lower concurrency to problematic upstreams 3) route partial traffic to standby upstreams 4) suppress noisy 5xx pages while we flip routes.
Priya Kaur: agreed. Ben, can you toggle CB and reduce concurrency? Ill run a targeted route shift and create a temporary silence.
Ben Ortiz: running: `rbctl cb enable --service=prod-gateway --upstream=transedge --max-fail=5 --reset=30s` and `rbctl set-concurrency --service=prod-gateway --upstream=transedge --concurrency=10`
Deploy-Bot: circuit-breaker change started by Ben Ortiz — change_id=cb-20260315-07
Ben Ortiz: CB enabled. reducing concurrency for mirroredge as well. Applying 30% traffic reroute to standby-edge: `rct route shift --svc=prod-gateway --to=standby-edge --pct=30`
SRE-Bot: Alert ALRT-20260315-303 suppressed by action_id=cb-20260315-07 for 20 minutes.
Priya Kaur: monitoring metrics… p95 latency fell from 1.9s to 0.9s after the partial shift. 5xx rate reduced to 0.45% in the next 5m window. good signal but still seeing small bursts.
Marco Li: follow-ups I'd like to capture in post-incident tuning: 1) don't page on single-upstream blips. 2) require sustained (>10m) or multi-route impact before paging. 3) tag pages by `upstream` so owner teams get targeted pages. 4) add anti-amplification check so retries don't push upstream over threshold.
Alice Nguyen: will add dashboard panels and new alert visuals: 5xx rate by upstream, p95/p99 latency per upstream, inflight requests per upstream, retry amplification ratio. filing ticket INC-2026-1023 and assigning to frontend observability.
Priya Kaur: draft alert rule change proposal: move to 10m window, rate-based, and upstream dimension. page only when either: (a) 5xx_rate_upstream > 0.6% for 10m AND affects >= 3% of total traffic, OR (b) global 5xx_rate > 1.0% for 5m. Also add p99 latency page if > 1.5s for 5m.
Priya Kaur: example alert YAML to discuss:
```
- alert: Gateway5xxByUpstream
  expr: (sum by (upstream)(rate(http_requests_total{job="prod-gateway",status=~"5.."}[10m]))
         / sum by (upstream)(rate(http_requests_total{job="prod-gateway"}[10m]))) * 100 > 0.6
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: pager
    team: eng-sre
    note: "upstream-scoped"
  annotations:
    runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/gateway-upstream-5xx
```
Marco Li: I like that. Also add a condition to only escalate to pager if either the upstream consumes >2% of SLO error budget or affects more than N routes (we can count distinct route tags). That will cut noise for small-service blips.
Ben Ortiz: I'll follow up with TransEdge and MirrorEdge support tickets and attach logs. vendor tickets: VT-9031 (TransEdge) and VT-9032 (MirrorEdge). asking for root cause and capacity/timeout settings.
Priya Kaur: handoff: I'm on-call for next 20 minutes. Marco you'll take over at 14:30Z — I'll leave notes in the runbook and link the route-change commands. If errors return above 1% please escalate to L3.
Alice Nguyen: dashboard PR created — panels for 5xx-by-upstream, p99 latency, inflight and retries. Linking here: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/gateway-ops (PR: GFX-789).
SRE-Bot: Incident INC-2026-1023 created by Alice Nguyen — https://issues.redwood/INC-2026-1023
Priya Kaur: post-incident action items (capture in INC-2026-1023):
- Alice: finalize dashboards and add alert-to-panel links (due EOD)
- Priya: update runbook with CB playbook, route-shift commands, retry-config recommendations, and how to use `silence` for transient mitigations (due tomorrow)
- Marco: propose pager-policy change to only page on sustained or multi-route impact, add upstream-scoped tags to alerts (due next week)
- Ben: vendor RCA follow-up and confirm throttling/backpressure limits from providers (due 3 days)
Priya Kaur: final note — recommend we implement automated detection of retry amplification (alerts when retry to success ratio > 2x) and add circuit-breaker defaults per upstream. I'll add these items to the runbook.
Marco Li: taking handoff now. will monitor for 30m. closing the suppression in 12m unless we see re-alerts.
Priya Kaur: thanks team. keeping this thread as the incident log. :white_check_mark:
